# Thorne and Veck: architecture walkthrough

**Date:** Thursday 24 September 2026

###### 00:00 - 00:20
**Marcus Oyelaran**

Our infosec team will not look at this without a written architecture.

###### 00:20 - 00:52
**Dom Selvon**

That is fair. I will send the architecture note today and Marcus will come back to us with the security questionnaire by Tuesday.

###### 00:52 - 01:05
**Marcus Oyelaran**

Yes, Tuesday works. I will have it from the team by then.
